description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git status with respect to ignored files and directories. It sets up various test scenarios involving .gitignore configurations, tracked, untracked, and ignored files, and verifies the output of 'git status' under different options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution and verification of subsequent commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes, typically cleanup commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output during tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
